name: Snowbird
about: Real on-mountain facilities, researched for the 3D scenes. Lifts are keyed by OSM way id (same as osm_snowbird.json). Buildings use lat/lon (the resort origin is not fixed yet). 'verified': false marks anything not confirmed by a lift database, the resort or a photo; colours are read from dated photos and are approximate hex. Buildings are placed by lat/lon (the resort's origin is not fixed yet); 'model' is the kit model drawn there, a landmark of its own where one was built from photos; lifts carry terminal_model, the maker's hood.
notes: Tram cabins replaced by CWA in 2022 (red and blue kept); the original red cabin is now the Tram Bar on the Tram Club patio.
Chickadee became a Skytrac fixed quad in summer 2026 (new bottom position; OSM still tags a double). Wilbere became a Doppelmayr fixed quad on a new line in 2024.
The Mid-Gad Restaurant was replaced by The Nest (opened 10 Dec 2025); OSM still has the old footprint.
Snowbird repainted its terminals bright blue (photos 2022-2023); older photos show white/green or white/blue hoods.
Lifts missing from OSM: the Chickadee Conveyor (skiresort.info people mover). The Cliff Lodge and The Summit are not in OSM as named buildings.
Lift photos: liftblog 2015-2026. Building photos: Reaveley Engineers project pages and liftblog.

10125080.name: Aerial Tram
10125080.note: Jig-back tram from the Snowbird Center to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) with two 125-passenger cabins, one red and one blue. New CWA cabins in 2022 (blue in early 2022, red later that year): near-black glazed body with floor-to-ceiling windows, glass floor panels, a coloured lower band and roof edge (red or blue) with a white 'snowbird' wordmark and white line-art of the peaks, a removable summer rooftop balcony, and a light-grey hanger with a grey carriage. Bottom dock is built into the Snowbird Center: a board-formed concrete A-frame portal with a deep overhanging roof. Top dock on Hidden Peak is an open grey steel-lattice structure on a concrete base next to the Summit building. Line towers are tall galvanised lattice towers with a cantilevered saddle (towers numbered up to 4). The original red cabin now sits on the Tram Club patio (Tram Bar, 2025).
10125080.note_kit: A jig-back tram: two cabins, no loop. The kit has tram_cabin, tower_tram, tram_dock_bottom and tram_dock_top; the ride still draws a cable_car as a gondola until it learns to run two cabins to and fro.

31845482.name: Peruvian
31845482.note: Peruvian Express: long Doppelmayr CTEC Uni-GS terminals (long-hood Uni-G variant) painted Snowbird's bright blue with a white 'peruvian express' wordmark; bottom beside the tram dock at the Snowbird Center, top just below Hidden Peak with vault drive and 90-degree unloading, next to the Peruvian Tunnel portal. Roller-coaster profile with many hold-down towers. Grey chairs, light grey towers with yellow base pads. Terminals were white with dark-green trim in older photos and are blue by 2023.

10124737.name: Gadzoom
10124737.note: Gad Valley's main detachable quad: early Garaventa CTEC Stealth terminals with a long window-band hood, all blue since c. 2022 (white-and-blue earlier) with a white 'gadzoom' wordmark. Many tower tubes reused from the old Doppelmayr Gad 1 double.

31845484.name: Gad 2
31845484.note: Gad 2 Express, Doppelmayr Uni-G terminals in Snowbird blue with dark glass roof and window; rust-red operator huts. Undulating line with depression towers.

31845483.name: Little Cloud
31845483.note: Little Cloud Express: blue Doppelmayr Uni-G terminals with dark glass roof panels, rust-red operator huts; drive-tension at the bottom, 90-degree unloading at the top.

31845480.name: Baldy
31845480.note: Baldy Express in Mineral Basin: Garaventa CTEC Stealth III terminals (top has 90-degree unloading), all blue by 2023 with a white 'baldy express' wordmark; the upper line bends slightly with canted sheaves.

31845481.name: Mineral Basin
31845481.note: Mineral Basin Express: early Garaventa CTEC Stealth terminals with a wide window-band hood, blue with white 'mineral basin express' lettering (the top on Hidden Peak still showed white/blue in a 2023 photo); bottom in Mineral Basin, drive at the top near the tram dock.

137670515.name: Mid-Gad Lift
137670515.note: Fixed-grip double from the Gad Valley base (Creekside) to the Nest (former Mid-Gad restaurant), with a mid-station unload. Newer Doppelmayr CTEC bottom drive-tension terminal with a blue hood and 'mid-gad' wordmark (green in older photos). Year from skiresort.info; not cross-checked.

137691201.name: Chickadee Lift
137691201.note: Replaced in early summer 2026 (built in 76 days): Skytrac fixed-grip quad with a Monarch top drive under a blue hood, loading conveyor, rust-brown operator hut; beginner lift by the Snowbird Center/Cliff Lodge. Replaced the 1972 double. The new bottom terminal is in a different place, so the OSM way (tagged as a double) may still show the old line.

137734920.name: Baby Thunder
137734920.note: Beginner double at the Gad Valley base: Doppelmayr bottom tension station with a timber operator hut, top drive bullwheel on a single post (motor room underground).

1213734247.name: Wilbere
1213734247.note: New 2024 fixed-grip quad on a new alignment from near Creekside Lodge, with a Chairkit loading conveyor; bottom tension station, Alpenstar fixed drive on top under a rounded blue hood; timber operator huts with a 'wilbere' sign. Replaced the old Wilbere double.

31845485.name: Peruvian Tunnel
31845485.note: About 600 ft (c. 180-200 m) tunnel through the Hidden Peak ridge from the top of Peruvian to Mineral Basin, with a 180 m Sunkid moving carpet in the middle; rough shotcrete arched walls lit by lamps, mining artefacts and framed photos along the walkways. Opened 12 Dec 2006. Exterior portals not photographed here.

976539206.name: Thunder Tube
976539206.note: Covered beginner carpet at the Gad Valley/Baby Thunder area (OSM bubble=yes means a covered gallery). Maker and year unknown; look not checked.

976562095.name: Conveyor #3
976562095.note: Very short carpet next to Thunder Tube (OSM gives 'Conveyor #3' also as Thunder Tube's alt name). Not confirmed by a lift list.

buildings.name: Snowbird Center (tram bottom dock)
buildings.style: The base hub on the plaza: stepped brutalist building of board-formed tan concrete with dark-framed glass bands and flat roofs; the tram dock rises out of it as a tall concrete A-frame portal with a heavy overhanging roof. Inside: ticketing, Forklift, General Gritts, Baked & Brewed, Tram Club (with the original red tram cabin on its patio), Steak Pit. Renovated 2018; pedestrian bridges to the Cliff Lodge and Lower Village (2018).
buildings.note: Number of levels not confirmed (several levels step down the slope). Needs its own model together with the tram dock.

buildings.name: Cliff Lodge
buildings.style: The landmark hotel: tall slab of raw board-formed concrete with recessed balconies on a regular grid and timber-brown balcony backs, plus a wing clad in dark mirror glass; flat roof; sits east of the Snowbird Center. Houses the Aerie (top floor), Atrium, SeventyOne and the Cliff Spa.
buildings.note: Not mapped as a building in OSM; position from the OSM node of The Aerie restaurant (level 10) inside it. Commonly described as 11 storeys; the photo shows about ten balcony floors above a glazed base. Footprint unknown.

buildings.name: The Summit (Hidden Peak)
buildings.style: Summit lodge at 11,000 ft beside the tram top dock (2015-2016): two-storey flat-roofed building of grey concrete panels with continuous floor-to-ceiling glazing on the upper floor, a rounded glass corner, a concrete stair/elevator tower carrying the Snowbird logo, an external concrete stair and a big concrete deck with Adirondack chairs.
buildings.note: Not in the OSM file as a building; position taken from the tram top station (w1306467021) and needs checking on a map.

buildings.name: Aerial Tram top dock
buildings.style: Open grey steel-lattice station frame with railings and a stair, standing on a concrete plinth/machinery room on the Hidden Peak ridge; cabin berth cantilevered over the slope.

buildings.name: The Nest (new Mid-Gad restaurant)
buildings.style: Opened 10 Dec 2025 on the site of the old Mid-Gad Restaurant at the top of the Mid-Gad lift: a glass dining hall wrapped on three sides by 145 floor-to-ceiling panels, with a diagonal timber/steel diagrid visible behind the glass, cantilevered on columns over the slope; flat roof with deep eave; low grey-panelled service wing with the Snowbird logo; heated deck (90 seats). 355 seats inside. GSBS Architects, Layton Construction.
buildings.note: The OSM footprint (27 x 24 m) is the old Mid Gad building; the new one is larger and the footprint should be redrawn.

buildings.name: Creekside Lodge
buildings.style: Gad Valley base lodge near the bottoms of Gadzoom, Mid-Gad and Wilbere; look not checked.

buildings.name: The Lodge at Snowbird
buildings.style: Condo hotel west of the Snowbird Center (Lodge Bistro inside); concrete-and-timber 1970s blocks; not checked closely.

buildings.name: The Inn at Snowbird
buildings.style: Condo hotel in the Lower Village; brown timber-and-concrete block seen behind the Cliff Lodge; not checked closely.

buildings.name: Iron Blosam Lodge
buildings.style: Long condo hotel in the Lower Village (The Wildflower restaurant inside); not checked.

buildings.style: Yurt at the Gad Valley base.

signature.name: Aerial Tram
signature.description: Two 125-passenger cabins, one red and one blue, shuttling 2.4 km from the concrete A-frame dock in the Snowbird Center to Hidden Peak over tall lattice towers; 2022 cabins are black glass boxes with a coloured band, white 'snowbird' wordmark and a rooftop balcony in summer.
signature.kit_note: Needs a tram model: large cabin + hanger + track/haul ropes, lattice towers, concrete A-frame bottom dock and steel top dock.

signature.name: Snowbird blue terminals
signature.description: All detachable terminals (Uni-G, Uni-GS, CTEC Stealth) and the new fixed lifts wear one bright azure blue with white lowercase wordmarks; rust-red operator huts.
signature.kit_note: terminal_detach exists; paint blue, add the long window-band CTEC variant.

signature.name: Cliff Lodge
signature.description: The raw concrete high-rise hotel with a grid of balconies and a black glass wing, visible from everywhere in the base.

signature.name: Peruvian Tunnel
signature.description: Ride a carpet through a lit mining-style tunnel under Hidden Peak into Mineral Basin.
signature.kit_note: magic_carpet exists; needs a tunnel portal + shotcrete tube.

signature.name: The Summit and The Nest
signature.description: Glass-and-concrete Summit on Hidden Peak at the tram top; the new glass diagrid Nest (2025) mid-mountain in Gad Valley.
signature.kit_note: restaurant model with large glazing; diagrid is new.
